column3: An insurance policy, a pension plan, an annuity, a provident fund plan or other similar plan

Includes the activity of any organisation, whether or not carried out for the purposes of gain, or conducted on a regular, repetitive or continuous basis, but does not include an individual acting in his personal or domestic capacity

An individual's name, position name or title, business telephone number, business address, business electronic mail address or business fax number and any other similar information about the individual, not provided by the individual solely for his personal purposes
Any organisation that provides education, including instruction, training or teaching, whether by itself or in association or collaboration with or by affiliation with any other person
